title: Components and props: Treat props as read-only inputs to a component, not mutable application state
description: Learn components and props with a React 19 model, TypeScript starter and solution, testable edge cases, a bug hunt and offline verification.
objectives: Explain the components and props contract and why it matters
Repair a deliberately broken react-props example
Verify the expected result and a failure or edge case with local tests
rubric: I can explain components and props without confusing a render model with mounted browser behavior.
I can repair the starter for 06.01.02, compare with the instructor solution and explain why the test fails before the repair.
I can verify representative and edge-case behavior locally and name at least one additional interaction test needed.
